title: Men Who Eat More Plant-Based Protein Have Higher Testosterone Levels - Nautilus
author: Jake Currie
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementHealthMen Who Eat More Plant-Based Protein Have Higher Testosterone LevelsRevenge of the soy boys?JCBy Jake Currie12:58 PM CDT on October 29, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleThere’s a testosterone crisis in America—at least according to a number of Trump administration officials. Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., for example, has bemoaned the low-T of the American youth, and even boosts his own levels with testosterone replacement therapy. He’s also a major proponent of eating animals, celebrating the prominent position of meat and dairy in the new food pyramid the US Department of Agriculture unveiled at the beginning of this year.But a study published last month in the International Journal of Food Sciences and Nutrition suggests Kennedy might be able to ease up on the testosterone shots if he ate more vegetables.A team of nutritional and metabolic scientists analyzed the four-day dietary intake and hormone levels of more than 2,500 middle-aged men living in Finland. It’s worth noting that the data in their study were also middle-aged, collected during the Kuopio Ischaemic Heart Disease Risk Factor Study between 1984 and 1989.Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
